correctness.rationale: A fully executable exact certificate constructs both 28-vertex graph models and verifies their 378-pair isomorphism; enumerates all 196009 independent subsets, checks all 98001 matching pairs and acyclicity of the entire oriented Hasse graph, leaving exactly seven critical six-faces; enumerates 336 distinct projective matrices, verifies each graph action, and computes signed Lefschetz traces via both quotient-conflict recursion and independent direct face sums for eight representatives. Only rational PGL2(7) character and no-invariants claims are accepted. Irreducibility follows from the two-transitive natural action. The proof does not extrapolate from sampled parameters.

value.rationale: The Coxeter graph has a canonical, highly nontrivial 336-element symmetry group. The precise seven-dimensional rational top-homology module is not determined by rank seven or the wedge topology: the quadratic twist reverses the order-eight character from -1 to +1, proving irreducibility and absence of globally invariant homology. This is the complete natural module classification for a historically significant graph, with a 336-element exhaustive exact proof rather than an arbitrary small invariant.
